scope: Eight independent Linux x86_64 boots, one paired actual OLD, historical RUF009 edit, first unchanged native build and three subsequent measurements per role. Four parent-first, four candidate-first. Fully empty OLD and independent clean NEW for every role.
correctness: All 350 actual Cargo units and four historical CLI answers must match; both edits change the exe and the edited, repaired and independently empty executables agree byte-for-byte within each toolchain. Both reject malformed native library and ill-typed real Ruff source. All file bytes across compilers must match except the GNU SHA-256 build ID and the three debug tables observed on the prior unscored worker. Require the entire remaining file, every decoded DWARF DIE and macro line, and the complete string multiset to agree accounting only for the actual SDK-keyed Cargo directory. Physically reopen archives and run four CLI probes on each executable.
primary: Paired ratio of retired user instructions for the first unchanged complete native build. All eight must satisfy every eligibility condition and each patched arm must use at most half of the original instructions. Use the paired median and exact two-sided sign test. Report the min-max distribution-free 99.21875% interval for eight. Never treat three further observations on a boot as independent.
secondary: Report the genuine edit alone, edit plus first unchanged, and each subsequent unchanged count. Report actual typed rustc and Wild invocations. No wall time claim. All rejected or missing boots remain visible.
census: Require the original 18 typed rustc processes, patched ruff and ty_python_semantic only, one genuine bundled Wild process per arm. Require register-only portable_atomic rlib and rmeta exact across arms, original marker on parent and absent on candidate. Both unmodified true/false hardware calibrations must retire positive unmultiplexed instructions.
